changeSet.author: hyperbrains
changeSet.comment:
When a prescription was written.
The medication entity carried no timestamp at all, so the pharmacy's dispensing queue could order work but could not say how long a patient had been waiting. Added nullable, backfilled from now() for any rows that predate it, then made required - so this is safe to apply to a database that already holds prescriptions.
This changeset is also where PrescriptionStatus.CANCELLED became reachable. That value needs no schema change of its own: the status column is a plain varchar with no check constraint, so there is nothing for Liquibase to alter.
